name: American Howa Kentucky, Inc. Georgetown Plant
old_description: With 33 manufacturing and R&D facilities in over a dozen countries worldwide, HOWA is able to meet our customers’ diverse needs on a global scale, while simultaneously responding to the unique demands of our local clientele.
about:
American Howa Kentucky, Inc. Georgetown Plant (AHK‑GT) was established in 2017 in Midway, Kentucky, as the fourth U.S. production site for HOWA USA Holdings, Inc. The Japanese parent, HOWA, operates 33 manufacturing and R&D facilities across over a dozen countries. The Kentucky operation began in 2007 with a plant in Bowling Green, adding sunshade and dash insulator production the following year.

The Georgetown facility manufactures automotive interior components including sunshades, dash insulators, felt, polyurethane foam, headliners, and interior trim. It operates PU foam production lines and supports on‑site headliner production for Nissan programs. The plant is part of a North American network that includes facilities in Bowling Green, Delaware (Ohio), Canton (Mississippi), and Alliston (Ontario).

The plant serves automotive original equipment manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers. Key customers include Nissan North America, Toyota Motor North America, American Honda Motor Co., Aisin World Corp. of America, and Webasto Product North America. Programs supported range from the Nissan Leaf and Frontier to the Murano and Titan, as well as Honda headliner programs.

HOWA's stated mission emphasizes employee well‑being, striving to be the sole manufacturer of unique products through boldness and creativity, building customer confidence via environmental conservation, achieving world‑leading satisfaction through continuous improvement, and contributing to local development while respecting diverse values.
